text.p: Watany Bank of Egypt said on Monday it made net profits of 42.407 million pounds ($12.47 million) in the first nine months of 1996.
It did not give a figure for the same period of 1995 but in the whole of last year it made net profits of 30.795 million pounds.

The bank increased its capital this year to 82.582 million pounds from 60.480 million at the end of 1995 and at the end of the nine-month period the value of shareholders' funds stood at 139.386 million against 85.567 million at end 1995, it said.

In the capital increase it sold new shares to existing shareholders at a discount from the market price. Shares are of two types, pound shares with a nominal value of 7.00 pounds and dollar shares with a nominal value of $2.06.
The bank's total assets at the end of September were 1.820 billion pounds against 1.446 billion at the end of 1995.
The pound shares closed on the Egyptian stock exchange on Sunday at 38.00 pounds, the dollar shares at $10.00.
